An Imperial '''engineer officer''' was a [[human]] member of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s<ref name="One Year Later" /> [[Imperial Engineering Corps|Engineering Corps]]<ref name="One Year Later" /> with the [[military rank]] of [[major]].<ref name="Rank">{{ImperialRanks-PreDS-LA}}</ref> In [[4 BBY]], the [[Imperial officer]] was one of a handful of Imperials personally requested by [[Director of Advanced Weapons Research]] [[Orson Callan Krennic]] to join the [[Ghorman project]], an initiative by Krennic to extract vital [[kalkite]] from the surface of the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]]. Such a project would likely destabilize the planet's core, and as such, the population needed to be handled in methods created by the project.<ref name="One Year Later" />

The [[Maltheen Divide conference|first meeting]] in a [[Maltheen Divide lodge|secret installation]] in the [[Maltheen Divide]] included representatives from the [[Ministry of Enlightenment]], the [[Imperial Security Bureau]], the [[Imperial Navy]], and the Science and Engineering Division. The [[engineer]] officer, among these members, responded to ISB [[Major]] [[Lio Partagaz]]'s question on the process being invasive, stating that the extraction process would present difficult challenges to the local [[Ghorman (people)|Ghorman]] population as the extent of the Imperial extraction would give stress to the planet's core and render it unstable. After a pause in official business, both the [[science]] major and Major Partagaz spoke further on the subject, with the science officer stating that the [[mining]] equipment was already warehoused and ready for transport. After Partagaz asked how long was needed to begin, the officer replied that the drilling was simple, as the operation could start in several weeks.<ref name="One Year Later" />

The officer continued that it was the security and administration issues that were the issue with the project. Partagaz proclaimed that the Empire did not have a large enough presence on the planet, and the officer replied that Director Krennic already planned for that subject as the Empire would build a new armory on the [[city]] [[Palmo]] as a pretext for the larger Imperial presence.<ref name="One Year Later" />

==Behind the scenes==
The officer debuted in "[[One Year Later]]," the premier episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''. The officer was portrayed by actor [[Tom Bonington]], and the episode released on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="One Year Later" />
